statement: The program must keep a bit-coded running object snap mode (default 4133) where bits 1 to 8192 turn on endpoint, midpoint, center, node, quadrant, intersection, insertion, perpendicular, tangent, nearest, geometric center, apparent intersection, extension and parallel snaps, and bit 16384 temporarily suppresses all running snaps.
superiority: Typed snap set with named bits and per-command presets.

acceptance.sketch: Set OSMODE 33: only endpoint and intersection snap; value readable back as 33; 16384 bit disables all running snaps.

notes: Verified against help page "OSMODE (System Variable)". | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Osnap; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide ORTHOMODE (drawing-saved 0 or 1) to constrain cursor movement to horizontal or vertical relative to the UCS and grid rotation, and the bit-coded POLARMODE setting (default 0) for relative polar angle measurement (1), polar settings in snap tracking (2), additional polar angles (4) and Shift-to-acquire tracking points (8).

acceptance.sketch: ORTHOMODE 1 constrains; POLARMODE bits set tracking behavior; readable and writable by script.

notes: Verified against help page "ORTHOMODE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D91628CC-9975-4DBF-8D02-10B23A6F3ED5 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Ortho; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide AUTOSNAP as a bit-coded display setting (default 63: marker 1, tooltip 2, magnet 4, polar tracking 8, snap tracking 16, tracking tooltips 32), APERTURE as the object-snap target box size from 1 to 50 (default 10), and PICKBOX as the selection pickbox height in device-independent pixels (default 3).

acceptance.sketch: PICKBOX 5 selects within 5 px; APERTURE 10 changes snap radius.

notes: Verified against help page "AUTOSNAP (System Variable)". Corrected: Original said aperture in pixels and omitted that AUTOSNAP also toggles tracking and tooltips; APERTURE is the snap target box only, PICKBOX is the selection box. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2AA8CF8E-267F-4BD6-80CD-0E7C48B8A9F1 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-363698CF-C3DC-4770-81EF-CB09D86B3D3A | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must keep per-viewport grid on/off (GRIDMODE, initial 1) and snap on/off (SNAPMODE, initial 0) states plus X/Y grid spacing (GRIDUNIT, where 0,0 makes the grid follow snap spacing) and snap spacing (SNAPUNIT), all saved in the drawing with defaults of 0.5 imperial or 10 metric.

acceptance.sketch: GRIDUNIT 5,5 draws grid spacing 5; SNAPUNIT 2.5,2.5 snaps to 2.5 multiples.

notes: Verified against help page "GRIDMODE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-6E37252F-77E5-4266-8759-AAD5E5577F1C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D6B961E9-1D95-458E-BEA1-C9997789EDC2 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1E54C26E-F08A-4648-87D0-62217BD6AE58 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Grid, Snap; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must support DIMASSOC (integer, default 2, saved in drawing but not in dimension styles) so that new dimensions are created exploded into separate objects (0), as single non-associative objects (1) or as single associative objects tied to geometry (2).

acceptance.sketch: DIMASSOC 2 creates associative; 1 non-associative; 0 exploded lines.

notes: Verified against help page "DIMASSOC (System Variable)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide the dimension system variables stored in the drawing and in dimension styles, including DIMSCALE (overall scale, default 1), DIMTXT text height, DIMASZ arrowhead size, DIMEXO and DIMEXE extension line offset and extension, DIMGAP text gap, DIMDLI baseline spacing, DIMDEC decimal places, DIMLFAC linear measurement factor, and the DIMTAD, DIMTIH, DIMTOH and DIMTOFL text and line placement switches, with imperial and metric defaults.

acceptance.sketch: Set DIMTXT 3.5: next dimension text height 3.5; DIMSTYLE override resets with Apply.

notes: Verified against help page "DIMSCALE (System Variable)". Corrected: Variable names, types and defaults confirmed (e.g. DIMTXT 0.18 or 2.5, DIMDEC 4 or 2, DIMTAD 0 or 1). The claim about system variable overrides becoming style overrides is not on these pages; cover overrides in a DIMSTYLE row. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A17A69D7-25EF-4F57-B4EB-D53A56AB909C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-43E31690-BA17-4AD6-82D1-E7809BD1298A ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5CF50ABD-1F77-4609-BEB5-A129BF7DD746 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-508D4589-3C3E-4B5E-BA2C-539809197A71 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-EB367187-A5D6-404A-8121-A6D1D25B626A ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D2D1AF3D-004B-4C47-BABE-22B7327EE128 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8F311450-A848-4682-81A5-D0EC6E3499C9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B6063785-B199-4A9A-8BD7-2108EB0AB7ED ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-60D1241D-CEA7-4493-BD6A-4EF433F3C946 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-60CFA531-80FD-45EF-B529-F4FAF5C758B3 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-71B03AC9-ADC1-4859-A9CD-85247BACABBE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-40D7439D-C805-4373-879A-E19ACE97FE54 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must keep default text height TEXTSIZE (ignored for fixed-height styles) and current text style name TEXTSTYLE (default Standard) in the drawing, plus TEXTFILL (filled or outlined TrueType text when plotting) and TEXTQLTY (TrueType resolution 0 to 100 for plotting and rendering, default 50).

acceptance.sketch: TEXTSIZE 4 makes new text height 4; TEXTFILL 0 shows outline only.

notes: Verified against help page "TEXTSIZE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4F5D952E-63B6-4965-A050-84AEF2273B25 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8E1786B0-D31D-4A61-8A84-78E7BE34867B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1B6FA34A-99DC-4666-8ECD-D9B2BBEDEEAF | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide MIRRTEXT (default 0, saved in drawing) so MIRROR either keeps text readable and non-reversed (0) or mirrors text like other objects (1).

acceptance.sketch: Mirror text MIRRTEXT 0 leaves reading direction; 1 reflects.

notes: Verified against help page "MIRRTEXT (System Variable)". | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must support global linetype scale LTSCALE (non-zero, default 1), the new-object scale CELTSCALE relative to it, PSLTSCALE (default 1) choosing whether paper space viewport magnification or paper space units govern dash lengths, and MSLTSCALE (default 1) scaling Model tab linetypes by the annotation scale.

acceptance.sketch: LTSCALE 2 doubles dash length; CELTSCALE sets new object ltscale factor.

notes: Verified against help page "LTSCALE (System Variable)". Corrected: MSLTSCALE is about annotation scaling of model space linetypes, not paper space; PSLTSCALE covers paper space viewports. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-ECE175AB-AB7B-4DEC-9CEC-D5D67AF9310B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-23EA4D64-AE7D-41E5-A8D0-20F060313D62 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-023B046C-56EA-463C-A867-DF713666A69E | prior app hint: cand2 app registers SetLinetypeScale; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must keep drawing-saved defaults for new objects: current layer CLAYER (0), color CECOLOR (BYLAYER, ACI, true color or color book), linetype CELTYPE (BYLAYER), lineweight CELWEIGHT in hundredths of mm (-1 ByLayer, -2 ByBlock, -3 Default) and transparency CETRANSPARENCY (-1 ByLayer, -2 ByBlock, 0 to 90).

acceptance.sketch: CLAYER Walls: new objects drawn on Walls; CECOLOR 1 colors new objects red.

notes: Verified against help page "CLAYER (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-703858E3-9038-406A-B499-90A0C05BECBF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-28460EAB-7005-4E82-A97C-47A728F420E5 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E1B15CA7-C45D-4845-B1A6-2520F6F911F3 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-058580C9-43DE-4770-93C4-3DE1AB2F5287 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must store default radii and distances for editing commands: FILLETRAD (2D fillet radius, default 0, updated by FILLET), FILLETRAD3D (3D fillet radius for FILLETEDGE and SURFFILLET, default 1), CHAMFERA and CHAMFERB (two chamfer distances when CHAMMODE is 0) and CHAMFERC and CHAMFERD (chamfer length and angle when CHAMMODE is 1).

source.ref: FILLETRAD, CHAMFERA, CHAMFERB, FILLETRAD3D, CHAMFERC, CHAMFERD

acceptance.sketch: FILLETRAD 2 then FILLET uses radius 2 without prompt; CHAMFERA/B define distances.

notes: Verified against help page "FILLETRAD (System Variable)". Corrected: CHAMFERC and CHAMFERD are the length and angle pair for the 2D chamfer method (CHAMMODE 1), not 3D variables; only FILLETRAD3D is the 3D one. CHAMMODE needs its own row. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E2E34687-6BFF-481A-9732-885651AA44CF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-53D438C7-3179-4971-BC39-E0F878FD18CF ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-758FCCF3-8E13-4D60-9BC8-62231C8B3066 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FFFD13C0-3C7F-4865-B783-46E3BC652AC9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-19EB0506-005C-491A-B2E6-AF12890A3786 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must keep the default offset distance in OFFSETDIST (real, not saved, initial -1 where any negative value means offset through a point and 0 or more is a fixed distance) and an OFFSETGAPTYPE setting that makes offset polylines close gaps with extended, filleted or chamfered corners.

acceptance.sketch: OFFSETERASE 1 deletes source after offset; OFFSETDIST -1 means Through.

notes: Verified against help page "OFFSETDIST (System Variable)". Corrected: OFFSETDIST page read. OFFSETGAPTYPE has no System Variable page in the help set; it is only referenced from About Offsetting Objects. No help page found for OFFSETERASE (the Erase option is not documented as a variable here); that part should be dropped or verified separately. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-704C1ADE-A4AE-4A85-8822-454ACAC1345A | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide FILEDIA (default 1, 0 suppresses file dialogs in favor of command-line prompts, with a tilde forcing the dialog), CMDDIA (default 1, 0 hides the on-canvas text editor and some dialogs so scripts can run) and CMDECHO (default 1, not saved, 0 stops prompts and input echoing during AutoLISP command calls).

acceptance.sketch: FILEDIA 0 makes file prompts typed at the command line; CMDECHO 0 hides prompts in LISP.

notes: Verified against help page "FILEDIA (System Variable)". Corrected: FILEDIA only governs file dialogs; the text editor and other dialogs are CMDDIA; CMDECHO affects only the AutoLISP command function echo. All three default to 1 (original implied scripts need FILEDIA 0 and CMDECHO 0 by default). Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-CFB4A601-A0BF-49F0-856B-EEE1543A7E03 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E7599129-5A3B-4121-A0C3-A625CA96E55B | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must support noun-verb selection via PICKFIRST (default 1), additive selection via PICKADD (0, 1 or 2, default 2), automatic window/crossing/lasso starting via bit-coded PICKAUTO (default 5) and the two-click or click-drag window method via PICKDRAG (default 2).

acceptance.sketch: PICKFIRST 1 allows select then command; PICKDRAG 1 allows click-drag windows.

notes: Verified against help page "PICKFIRST (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-47C2A568-30EE-4F07-916F-884CDE25CBCA ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7BAAA374-8409-4296-B520-C5355941C836 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-46CBF4EF-E210-447D-AE6E-793249551640 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide HIGHLIGHT (on or off, default 1), SELECTIONPREVIEW (bitcode, default 3: rollover highlight when idle and during object selection prompts) and SELECTIONCYCLING (0 off, 1 overlap badge, 2 badge plus selection list, default 0) for selection feedback.

acceptance.sketch: SELECTIONCYCLING 2 shows list on overlap.

notes: Verified against help page "HIGHLIGHT (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-77B3B59F-95E5-4F8A-85E2-D9411D712AF0 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-08FA6975-49A7-4029-A3F3-ABDA3B2A7122 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide UCSFOLLOW (per-viewport automatic plan view on UCS change, default 0), UCSICON (icon visibility and placement 0 to 3, default 3, per viewport and layout), UCSORTHO (auto-align UCS when restoring an orthographic view, default 1) and UCSVP (whether each viewport keeps its own locked UCS, default 1).

acceptance.sketch: UCSFOLLOW 1 changes to plan on UCS change; UCSVP 0 shares UCS.

notes: Verified against help page "UCSFOLLOW (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BCC7DA63-7F74-4F61-8605-E36A010FD33A ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A8E18ED4-F2FA-4D8D-9FEA-7F19DA3D3B43 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F71044DB-48DE-4D02-89E4-B1C2BC4C64A0 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must expose TILEMODE (1 Model tab, 0 a layout, default 1), CVPORT (current viewport number, settable to another active viewport), MAXACTVP (maximum active viewports in a layout, default 64) and read-only VPMAXIMIZEDSTATE (0 or 1) as space and viewport state.

acceptance.sketch: TILEMODE 0 shows layout; CVPORT identifies active viewport; MAXACTVP limits.

notes: Verified against help page "TILEMODE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5FAAE9D9-31BB-4C8A-BA84-808610B59EB9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-86846A4D-4E21-4E62-A710-E7B55243452D ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-BB58132B-1CF7-439D-B409-7EB1885E6CB8 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide MEASUREMENT (0 imperial, 1 metric, selects hatch pattern and linetype files), INSUNITS (drawing unit used to auto-scale inserted blocks, images and xrefs, 0 unspecified, initial 1 imperial or 4 metric) and INSUNITSDEFSOURCE (assumed source content units, 0 to 20, used when INSUNITS is 0).

acceptance.sketch: MEASUREMENT 1 uses acadiso.lin; INSUNITSDEFSOURCE sets default units for inserted content.

notes: Verified against help page "MEASUREMENT (System Variable)". Corrected: INSUNITSDEFSOURCE is the source content units used when INSUNITS is 0, not a default for insertion units; INSUNITS carries the unit list (inches, feet, miles, mm, cm, m, ...). Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A58A87BB-482B-4042-A00A-EEF55A2B4FD8 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4C21BD16-8C17-4469-A91C-F7CC105B770F | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Units; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide drawing-saved unit settings: LUNITS (1 scientific to 5 fractional, default 2), LUPREC (0 to 8, default 4), AUNITS (0 decimal degrees to 4 surveyor, default 0), AUPREC (0 to 8, default 0), ANGBASE (zero angle relative to the UCS), ANGDIR (0 counterclockwise, 1 clockwise) and UNITMODE (report or input display format of measured values).

source.ref: LUNITS, LUPREC, AUNITS, AUPREC, ANGBASE, ANGDIR, UNITMODE

acceptance.sketch: LUNITS 4 architectural; ANGDIR 1 clockwise positive.

notes: Verified against help page "LUNITS (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5FFF39D6-EFC7-49F5-B56A-6023EB5C0DE7 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C7C0F6A5-7982-43DB-97F9-5B9B0044E9FA ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-EE1ED20C-1096-4299-820F-83F1BC9B96F3 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B7CAB5F3-16BC-4E06-97BC-AAAEC052727E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A432574D-35B6-4D9E-8D8F-4259F2066234 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C52134E8-10EB-4AE7-A0C0-8F798C68F823 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Units; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide ISOLINES (0 to 2047 contour lines on curved solid faces, default 4), FACETRES (0.01 to 10 smoothness of shaded and hidden-line output, default 0.5), DISPSILH (silhouette edges on 3D solids and surfaces in 2D wireframe and HIDE), SURFU and SURFV (0 to 200 surface density, default 6) and DRAGMODE (drag outline display, default 2).

source.ref: ISOLINES, FACETRES, DISPSILH, SURFU, SURFV, DRAGMODE

superiority: Display is exact analytic with no user knob.

acceptance.sketch: ISOLINES 8 shows 8 lines per surface; FACETRES 1 vs 10 changes smoothness; DISPSILH 1 displays silhouettes.

notes: Verified against help page "ISOLINES (System Variable)". Corrected: DRAGMODE controls how dragged objects are displayed, not a 3D setting. DISPSILH has no stand-alone page in the help set; it is described in About Controlling the Display of Edges. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2DF46705-EE9E-409F-86B5-ED391CE207DC ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-651DFAD4-8A22-4C48-9DD5-E5751BDBE055 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-13E30946-F85A-4E74-8B2D-5A627C21093E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0690A755-3B81-44E7-9AB2-5DFED263642F ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7CFAD837-E8D5-496E-B0CF-EAC773709392 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide SAVETIME (autosave interval in minutes 0 to 600, 0 off, default 10, written to the SAVEFILEPATH folder), ISAVEBAK (create BAK file on save, default 1), ISAVEPERCENT (0 to 100 incremental-save allowance, default 50), SAVEFIDELITY (annotative visual fidelity when saving to 2007 or earlier formats, default 1) and a read-only SAVEFILE holding the current autosave file name.

acceptance.sketch: SAVETIME 5 enables 5-minute autosave; SAVEFIDELITY 1 saves annotation fidelity data.

notes: Verified against help page "SAVETIME (System Variable)". Corrected: SAVEFILE is a read-only file name, not a location (location is SAVEFILEPATH); SAVEFIDELITY only applies when saving to AutoCAD 2007 or earlier formats; ISAVEPERCENT controls incremental save space and needs no extra row. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-25AF36C1-CA4A-4C1C-8D93-1C4F436C6C25 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-469DFA87-1986-4BDA-918B-1E3F9D6FCDC2 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0D4C8D4B-6A37-4D74-BEE4-E00459B4F1ED ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2C7A305A-951E-49F3-9804-4C9CD23270E5 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Save; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must expose read-only DWGNAME (current file name, Drawing1.dwg when unsaved), DWGPREFIX (folder path), DWGTITLED (0 or 1 named flag) and DWGCODEPAGE (same value as SYSCODEPAGE), plus DWGCHECK (default 1) which warns on open about drawings saved by non-Autodesk applications or corrupt files.

acceptance.sketch: DWGPREFIX returns folder path ending with separator; DWGNAME returns file name.

notes: Verified against help page "DWGCODEPAGE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A89861EF-5F4F-46C6-A1DB-9D985A3858C9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-479EAE14-5A70-4FDD-8ACD-D75E5548386B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1CA841EC-0313-4A34-8829-0CC0B5FB6FEE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-91E890BF-AEBD-4BCE-9663-1AFD595AA5E4 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide five general-purpose string variables USERS1 to USERS5 (empty by default, not saved) and companion integer USERI1-5 and real USERR1-5 variables so macros and AutoLISP can store and retrieve scratch values.

acceptance.sketch: USERI1 42 survives save and reopen.

notes: Verified against help page "USERS1-5 (System Variable)". Corrected: Only the USERS1-5 System Variable page exists in the help set (type String, not saved). USERI1-5 and USERR1-5 have no page found; USERR1 appears in the DIESEL functions reference. Original said all three kinds are stored in the drawing, which the USERS page contradicts. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F94A885A-4DA2-432B-AC1A-EB49CC6C1C72 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide ANNOAUTOSCALE (add the new scale to annotative objects when the annotation scale changes, negative means off but remembered), ANNOALLVISIBLE (show annotative objects that lack the current scale, per space), CANNOSCALE (current annotation scale name, default 1:1) and ANNOTATIVEDWG (drawing inserts as an annotative block, read-only once annotative objects exist).

acceptance.sketch: ANNOAUTOSCALE -4 adds scales on scale change to all; CANNOSCALE "1:50" sets scale.

notes: Verified against help page "ANNOAUTOSCALE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-D8E50F6F-FB71-4A20-A3B9-7701C0518B81 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C7111BEE-76AA-481D-AC51-8600A31FA23A ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1720C9E3-B398-42FB-A5CA-6C983399FB04 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide PDMODE (point symbol: 0, 2, 3, 4 geometric forms, 1 invisible, plus 32, 64, 96 enclosing shapes, default 0) and PDSIZE (0 means 5 percent of drawing area height, positive absolute, negative percent of viewport), applied to existing points on the next regeneration.

acceptance.sketch: PDMODE 34 draws circle with cross.

notes: Verified against help page "PDMODE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-826CA91D-704B-400B-B784-7FCC9619AFB9 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide VIEWRES (curve tessellation per viewport, saved in the drawing), WHIPARC (0 shows circles and arcs as vectors per VIEWRES, 1 allows true arcs when the graphics hardware supports it) and MAXSORT (alphabetical sort limit for lists, default 1000), and accept REGENMODE only as a non-functional script-compatibility variable.

acceptance.sketch: WHIPARC 1 smooths circles; VIEWRES unaffected in the new graphics model.

notes: Verified against help page "WHIPARC (System Variable)". Corrected: REGENMODE is listed in the obsolete variables reference as no longer needed for performance and non-functional (retained for script compatibility). VIEWRES is documented as a command page whose prompt retains a legacy fast zoom option that is ignored; RTREGENAUTO is the live regen-during-pan variable. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-77B1C617-E4BB-4D1E-823A-8E2B055B258E ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-7AD30968-4982-4E1C-9847-69A5EAEB7C63 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5647ACE3-412E-48A6-8C1B-6B0EE09F5E3F ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9B52A286-BFCD-47B7-9FAC-197BBDB246D8 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide the TASKBAR setting for how open drawings appear as peek previews on the Windows taskbar and a single-document (SDI) versus multiple-document mode switch that affects the Start tab.

acceptance.sketch: SDI 1 single document interface.

notes: Verified against help page "TASKBAR (Command)". Corrected: Only TASKBAR has a help page (listed as a Command page). SDI is only referenced from the STARTMODE page; no help page was found for MDIACTIVE or MAXTAB, so those parts are unverified. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-143F3607-7D7F-4CC9-9BE4-2A221DF2D776 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must restrict loading of executable code files (ARX, LSP, FAS, VLX, DLL, .NET, VBA, scripts) to folders in TRUSTEDPATHS according to SECURELOAD (0 any location, 1 warn outside trusted folders, 2 allow only trusted folders, default 1) and must not search the program start folder or the drawing folder for executables unless LEGACYCODESEARCH is 1 (default 0).
superiority: Signed loadable code and sandboxed scripts.

acceptance.sketch: SECURELOAD 2 refuses code outside trusted paths; LISPINIT 0 keeps LISP variables across drawings.

notes: Verified against help page "TRUSTEDPATHS (System Variable)". Corrected: All three pages read. LISPINIT has no page in the help set so the per-drawing LISP reinitialization claim is unverified; add a separate row if confirmed. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-541566C6-2738-49DD-87C3-C1490E924A02 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1E582989-79A5-4B88-A9C2-8826E3FF9430 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide bit-coded FIELDEVAL (default 31: update fields on open 1, save 2, plot 4, eTransmit 8, regeneration 16) and FIELDDISPLAY (default 1) showing fields with a gray background that is not plotted.

acceptance.sketch: FIELDEVAL 31 updates on open/save/plot/etransmit/regen.

notes: Verified against help page "FIELDEVAL (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-99DB691B-9E11-4BD5-AFFE-BC1312F3281A | prior app hint: cand2 app registers UpdateFields; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide default settings for new hatches: pattern name HPNAME (ANSI31 or ANGLE), scale HPSCALE (1) and angle HPANG (0) as session values, drawing-saved HPCOLOR, HPLAYER and HPTRANSPARENCY (default use current), HPORIGIN (0,0), plus HPASSOC (associative, default 1) and HPGAPTOL (gap tolerance 0 to 5000, default 0).

source.ref: HPNAME, HPSCALE, HPANG, HPCOLOR, HPASSOC, HPGAPTOL, HPORIGIN, HPLAYER, HPTRANSPARENCY

acceptance.sketch: HPSCALE 2 HPANG 45: new hatch uses these; HPGAPTOL 1 allows 1 unit gap.

notes: Verified against help page "HPNAME (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B002D6D9-7CF2-43B7-B78F-10BEA710C430 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5D218A6C-F3AE-419A-8F0C-0AD704E9CDE9 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C5ACE97D-E19F-4F81-B3DA-0F86A688C414 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4875C3C9-77E8-49F9-8E91-C89084C76733 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-E58FDE75-CDB6-4625-83A8-D0BA4CF6A96A ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-38993CD0-3F26-400C-BCAF-F82057A059DD ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-8B64F625-7DD2-4264-8E59-3936F0992070 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C12451CF-470A-48B2-83A7-92BC0E873936 | prior app hint: cand2 app registers Hatch; behavior and option coverage not verified against this row.

statement: The program must provide PLINEWID (default polyline width, 0), PLINEGEN (0 linetype restarts at each vertex, 1 continuous pattern), PLINETYPE (optimized lightweight 2D polylines, default 2) and PELLIPSE (0 true ellipse object, 1 polyline ellipse).

acceptance.sketch: PELLIPSE 1 makes ellipse as polyline arcs; PLINEGEN 1 continues linetype pattern.

notes: Verified against help page "PLINEWID (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-352844E4-FBEA-44E0-B8F3-41C4187AD9C7 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F6027128-2707-4BBE-A0A4-C757435D4874 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A1C64346-BBFC-4FE9-B346-BCD121BEFA0A | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must keep settable defaults ELEVATION (new object elevation relative to the UCS, 0) and THICKNESS (3D thickness for new 2D objects, 0), and read-only per-viewport view state: TARGET and VIEWDIR (perspective target point and viewing direction), VIEWCTR (view center), VIEWSIZE (view height) and VIEWTWIST (rotation relative to WCS).

source.ref: ELEVATION, THICKNESS, TARGET, VIEWDIR, VIEWCTR, VIEWSIZE, VIEWTWIST

acceptance.sketch: VIEWCTR reads view center coordinates; VIEWSIZE reads the visible height in drawing units.

notes: Verified against help page "ELEVATION (System Variable)". Corrected: ELEVATION and THICKNESS are writable creation defaults; only TARGET, VIEWDIR, VIEWCTR, VIEWSIZE and VIEWTWIST are read-only view values. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-525A7B6F-414C-4EF7-A208-B79D9524DB66 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0649E4B8-B11A-411E-96CE-125BEBEB5B42 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-30ED47BF-A7B7-4331-B1AF-976FCCD0FBCB ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-6F641FE3-8F12-491A-905B-A097D5B9718B ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-31B50CD0-4943-4E9B-8735-C15CB3C4268C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-5357731F-8FC6-4413-A7B2-3E152CD3127B | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must store the last specified point in LASTPOINT (settable, referenced by the @ prefix, not saved), the end tangent angle of the last line, arc or polyline in read-only LASTANGLE, and the latest results of DIST in DISTANCE, of AREA and MEASUREGEOM in AREA, and of AREA, LIST, DBLIST and MEASUREGEOM in PERIMETER, all read-only and not saved.

source.ref: LASTPOINT, LASTANGLE, DISTANCE, AREA, PERIMETER, VOLUME

acceptance.sketch: After DIST: DISTANCE equals result; AREA after AREA.

notes: Verified against help page "LASTPOINT (System Variable)". Corrected: LASTPOINT is writable and LASTANGLE is relative to the UCS XY plane. PERIMETER also comes from LIST and DBLIST. No VOLUME system variable page found in the help set; MASSPROP is its own command. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FBD5ACF2-BEB9-4159-8F76-AE464DE2DF6F ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F55E2C37-515A-4560-B3BC-C2EE09A7F60D ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-CD078D73-FE99-49A0-8FFA-0D2FFA906167 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-A4F61BB1-2B36-41FE-8B67-FDABB2F62814 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must keep drawing limits LIMMIN (default 0,0) and LIMMAX (12,9 imperial or 420,297 metric) per space, LIMCHECK (0 or 1, blocks creating objects outside limits) and read-only EXTMIN and EXTMAX giving the lower-left and upper-right drawing extents in world coordinates.

acceptance.sketch: LIMCHECK 1 prevents points outside limits; EXTMIN/MAX reflect geometry bounds.

notes: Verified against help page "LIMMIN (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-CB4FA7B5-7041-481F-858C-C9BFE4AAC660 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-84DE5754-71A8-4CA7-91C4-05E0463D2BAB ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-F37FCEB8-FD86-4E8A-9DB3-A5163B2C0AE0 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-B3926CFA-DE74-4661-A9A5-2738A1FD937B | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide bit-coded SHORTCUTMENU (default 11) controlling right-click default, edit and command shortcut menus and press-and-hold display, DBLCLKEDIT (default 1) enabling double-click editing, and COMMANDPREVIEW (0 or 1, default 1) previewing results of commands such as TRIM, EXTEND, BREAK, LENGTHEN and ERASE.

acceptance.sketch: COMMANDPREVIEW bit shows preview for FILLET, TRIM.

notes: Verified against help page "SHORTCUTMENU (System Variable)". Corrected: COMMANDPREVIEW is only 0 or 1; the value 3 in the original is wrong (3 is the SELECTIONPREVIEW default). USERINPUT is not a system variable (only the ACTUSERINPUT command exists); right-click behavior is SHORTCUTMENU. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-0A1763AF-D682-4776-99BA-E64BC2B0D286 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-2B245436-029A-4E14-92C2-0ED4F4F1362E | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide DYNMODE (0 off, 1 pointer input, 2 dimensional input, 3 both, default 3, negative stores while off), DYNPROMPT (prompts in tooltips, default 1), DYNPICOORDS (0 relative or 1 absolute pointer coordinates, default 0), DYNDIGRIP (bitcode of dynamic dimensions during grip stretch, default 31) and DYNDIVIS (how many are shown, 0 to 2, default 1).

acceptance.sketch: DYNMODE 3 enables pointer and dimension inputs.

notes: Verified against help page "DYNMODE (System Variable)". Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-FA6A4CC1-DF9D-452C-93EA-48FFD0E08E1C ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-87D649DF-8474-4F55-806E-604906030B36 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-1EB33CCE-EF2C-4334-A90D-F8D5DAC9B0FA ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-C2BB4EEB-D3FC-40AC-B479-A6E001E90947 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must expose read-only LOCALE (code for the current product language), MENUNAME (path and name of the current customization file) and CPROFILE (name of the current user profile) as environment information.

acceptance.sketch: Product reading localized message with language file; user profile settings export and import (ARG).

notes: Verified against help page "LOCALE (System Variable)". Corrected: No LANGUAGE or PROFILE system variable page found; the current-profile variable is CPROFILE (read-only string, initial <<Unnamed Profile>>). LOCALE is a read-only language code, not a setting. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-9F0A50EB-0A85-473E-9AF5-184B25B81D40 ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-07A23914-0704-4C4F-B484-1BB6C965BAA3 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide a system variable monitor with a user-defined list of variables and preferred values that notifies on the command line, status bar and optionally by balloon when a value differs, and offers a Reset All action restoring the preferred values, with the notification level held in SYSMON (0 off, 1 on, 2 on with balloon, default 1).

acceptance.sketch: Changing a monitored variable shows a prompt; Reset restores original.

notes: Verified against help page "SYSVARMONITOR (Command)". Corrected: SYSVARMONITOR is a command (opens the System Variable Monitor dialog), so kind changed from setting to command; SYSMON is the associated system variable. Also see: https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-98A191B8-8F2C-488B-A14D-ED11B2D635DE ; https://help.autodesk.com/view/ACD/2025/ENU/?guid=GUID-4C530D78-D0EF-4FEF-ADC1-295A36655067 | prior app hint: no matching registration found in the cand2 app command registry.

statement: The program must provide SETENV (documented for AutoCAD LT) to view and set the value of registry variables such as MaxArray and MaxHatch.

acceptance.sketch: Run SETENV for MaxArray with value 100000 and assert an ARRAY exceeding 100000 elements is rejected while a smaller one succeeds.

notes: Added from help page "SETENV (Command)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: CENTERCROSSSIZE and CENTERCROSSGAP must accept relative values (with an x suffix, scaled by radius), absolute values, or ByLineType, and determine the size of the center cross and its gap to the centerline extensions accordingly.

source.ref: Center mark size and gap (CENTERCROSSSIZE, CENTERCROSSGAP)

acceptance.sketch: Set CENTERCROSSSIZE to 0.1x and create center marks on circles of radius 5 and 10 and assert the cross size is 0.5 and 1; set 0.1 and assert both are 0.1.

notes: Added from help page "Center Mark Size and Gap Reference"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.

statement: The web app must support the PDMODE system variable controlling point display style: values 0, 2, 3, 4 select geometric marks, 1 shows nothing, and adding 32, 64 or 96 draws a surrounding shape, with existing points updating on the next regeneration.

acceptance.sketch: Create a point, set PDMODE to 3 and then 35, regenerate, and assert the point shows an X and then an X inside a circle.

notes: Added from help page "PDMODE (System Variable)"; statement written from the opening part of that page (about the first 1,300 to 1,500 characters), so options further down the page were not reviewed.
